fusions.name: Read the Opening
fusions.desc: Bashes with the shield's boss, which deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every tenth of its health the target still has, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Kata's End
fusions.desc: Turns a full circle on the shield's rim, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Second Nature
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Practice Pays
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Its effect increases by 9% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
